statement.excerpt: Washington’s favorite fantasy right now seems to be that we will “beat” China if we “win” the Generative AI race, as if either side had any chance of completely dominating GenAI .
statement.document_title: Why ChatGPT can’t be trusted with breaking news

our_interpretation: The forecast concerns the United States and China, rather than the separate characterization of Washington's beliefs.
The ordinary reading of complete dominance is sustained, comprehensive superiority in generative AI capability and adoption, leaving the other country without a meaningful competitive position.
A lead in selected benchmarks, investment, or infrastructure is insufficient.
No numerical dominance threshold or duration is supplied, and none is invented.
The categorical exclusion can be refuted by dominance occurring; continued competition cannot establish that dominance will never occur.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes that complete dominance by either country is impossible over the open-ended horizon. A finite period of competition is insufficient.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible evidence establishes that either country has achieved sustained, comprehensive dominance in generative AI capability and adoption.
